name_de: Cube Stereo Hybrid ONE77 HPC AT 800 actionteam
name_en: Cube Stereo Hybrid ONE77 HPC AT 800 actionteam
description_de: Das Cube Stereo Hybrid ONE77 HPC AT 800 actionteam ist ein vollgefedertes E-Mountainbike von Cube. Der Antrieb (Bosch Performance Line CX) mit bis zu 120 Nm Drehmoment wird von einem 800-Wh-Akku gespeist, bedient wird er über Bosch Kiox 400C. Federung: Fox 38 Float Factory GRIPX2, Tapered, 15x110mm, E-Bike Optimized, 170mm · Dämpfer Fox Float X2 Factory, 230x65mm, High/Low Speed Rebound &…. Schaltung: Shimano XTR Di2 RD-M9260, 12-Speed, Electronic Shifting System. Bremsen: Shimano XTR BR-M9220, Hydr. Disc Brake w/ Front ABS (203/203). Rahmen: Carbon Front Triangle. Erhältlich in den Größen S, M, L, XL.
description_en: The Cube Stereo Hybrid ONE77 HPC AT 800 actionteam is a full-suspension electric mountain bike from Cube. The drive (Bosch Performance Line CX) with up to 120 Nm of torque is powered by an 800 Wh battery, controlled via Bosch Kiox 400C. Suspension: Fox 38 Float Factory GRIPX2, Tapered, 15x110mm, E-Bike Optimized, 170mm · Dämpfer Fox Float X2 Factory, 230x65mm, High/Low Speed Rebound &…. Drivetrain: Shimano XTR Di2 RD-M9260, 12-Speed, Electronic Shifting System. Brakes: Shimano XTR BR-M9220, Hydr. Disc Brake w/ Front ABS (203/203). Frame: Carbon Front Triangle. Available in sizes S, M, L, XL.
